evals.prompt: Use this robot reference image to create a draggable animated 3D web pet with a private voice backend and an editable Blender source.
evals.expected: Produces a reference analysis, design-lock signature, editable asset, exact named action contract, GLB, plugin contract, private speech boundary and QA evidence.

evals.prompt: Replace the current pet with this animal mascot image but keep the host chat adapters and user preferences compatible.
evals.expected: Preserves the plugin and adapter contract while rebuilding only the asset and state animation mapping.

evals.prompt: Package the new pet for a private Git repository, delete the visible modification history, and keep only the latest version.
evals.expected: Requires explicit destructive-publication authorization, creates a local bundle, builds a clean final-only snapshot, force-pushes one root commit, and verifies private visibility, single-commit history, tracked paths and remote SHA.

evals.prompt: The blink makes the eyes disappear, Bounce and Mischief look wrong, and the close button overlaps the feet. Correct only these problems.
evals.expected: Preserves accepted geometry, keeps compressed eyes visible, rebuilds readable decisive poses with exact recovery, hardens stale completion handling, and proves controls do not overlap the pet in a real browser.

evals.prompt: Include a downloadable introduction-page preview in the Skill so anyone can replace the example with their own pet.
evals.expected: Uses the bundled self-contained preview, replaces all character-specific media and copy, keeps assets local, and verifies desktop/mobile layout, video playback, links, console and requests.
